description: Change some fields of an event (id from google_calendar_list_events or create). What is not given stays: moving only from/to keeps the day, moving only date keeps the hours (and the length of a multi-day event). attendees replaces the list; they are emailed only with sendInvitations true.

attendees.description: Guests' email addresses. Invited (Google emails them, and again on every change) only with sendInvitations true

calendarId.description: The calendar's id (from google_calendar_ensure_calendar). Omit to use the calendar named calendarName

calendarName.description: The calendar TaskLite keeps in the Google account, found or created by this name. Default "פגישות"

endDate.description: Last day YYYY-MM-DD, for an event over several days

from.description: Start time HH:MM. Leave from and to out for an all-day event

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

sendInvitations.description: Email the attendees. Default false: only with the person's clear wish

timeZone.description: IANA timezone the dates and times are in, default "Asia/Jerusalem"

name: google_calendar_update_event
